subject: Intermittent 5xxs and elevated token latency — Cortex Retail
messages:
From: Sanjay Patel <spatel@cortexretail.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Heather Mills <heather@cortexretail.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T08:12:00-08:00
Subject: Unexpected 5xxs + slow token returns since 07:00 PT

Hi Jasmine / Marissa,

We started seeing intermittent 5xxs and a large increase in per-token latency for inference calls to model "redwood/gpt-large" starting ~07:00 PT. Error rate is spiking to ~7% and some requests take 3-4x normal time to stream tokens. This is affecting our recommendation flow across multiple regions.

Attached is a short sample CSV with request timings (latency_snapshot_20261122.csv). We need urgent triage and a plan — customers are complaining on our side. Please advise next steps and ETA to mitigation.

Thanks,
Sanjay
Sanjay Patel
Head of Platform Engineering
Cortex Retail

Attachments: latency_snapshot_20261122.csv (csv)
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-22T08:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected 5xxs + slow token returns since 07:00 PT

Hi Sanjay — thank you for the heads up and for the CSV. I’m escalating immediately. Below is what we’re doing now:

1) Internal triage: Neha and Rishi are on it to surface traces/metrics and look at peering/DNS/firewall paths.
2) Temporary mitigation: if we see sustained egress path issues we’ll switch your tenant to the dedicated egress pool (no config change on your side) to remove the suspect peering hop. Expect 10-20 minutes for rollout.
3) Communication: I’ll update you within 30 minutes with an action plan and then again after mitigation.

Neha/Rishi — please attach early findings and an initial RCA hypothesis as soon as you can. Marissa and Vivek I’m looping you in for exec visibility.

-Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Account Lead, Strategic Customers
Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-22T09:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected 5xxs + slow token returns since 07:00 PT

Quick triage notes (prelim):
- Cluster metrics: token generation CPU looks normal; request queue depth increased on egress proxies servicing Cortex tenant.
- Networking: we see elevated DNS resolve latency for multiple resolver hops (median resolved time jumped from ~20ms to ~280ms), and TCP RTT shows spikes aligned with the 5xx windows.
- 5xx patterns: errors are HTTP 502/504 originating at our proxy layer (EdgeProxy) before reaching the model infra.

I’ve attached collected traces and a zipped set of request samples (prelim-traces-20261122.zip). My working hypothesis: intermittent DNS/peering retransmits causing proxy queues to accumulate and time out, surfacing as 5xxs and slow token streams.

Next steps I recommend: open a peering/DNS ticket with the cloud provider, ask EdgeProxy to surface connection queue metrics, and prepare the dedicated egress failover.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Senior Technical Support Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: prelim-traces-20261122.zip (zip)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-22T10:00:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected 5xxs + slow token returns since 07:00 PT

Triage update + suggested mitigation steps:
- Observations: BPF/tcpdump samples show repeated SYN/ACK retransmits across the VPC peering path (peer-a -> peer-b) and a burst of FIN/RSTs targeting the proxy frontends. Pacing indicates a transient packet loss on the peering link.
- EdgeProxy behaviour: our proxy's connection backlog is filling and hitting the accept queue limit intermittently; when that happens it returns 502.
- Short term mitigation: 1) Initiate immediate fallback to Cortex's dedicated egress pool (switch routing at the infra plane) to bypass the peering lane; 2) Request cloud peering escalation with packet captures (I've already prepared a routing-diff-1122.txt that highlights mismatched AS path metrics).
- Longer term: we should add health-based routing to avoid the peering path during instability and increase DNS resolver diversity for this tenant.

I’ve initiated a ticket with AWS peering support and attached the routing diff. EdgeProxy NOC has been paged.

-Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Network Engineer, Infra
Redwood Inference

Attachments: routing-diff-1122.txt (text)
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Patel <spatel@cortexretail.com>, Heather Mills <heather@cortexretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-22T10:40:00-08:00
Subject: Customer update: Mitigation started for 5xx/latency (expected improvement ETA 15-25m)

Hi Sanjay / Heather — short update: we rolled your tenant to the dedicated egress pool at 10:30 PT to avoid the congested peering path. Early signals: error rate has dropped from ~7% to ~1.2% and median per-token latency has reduced by ~45% in the streams we've sampled.

What we’re doing next:
- Rishi is coordinating with AWS peering to identify packet loss windows and will share the official capture.
- EdgeProxy NOC is auditing proxy backlog thresholds to ensure we don’t hit accept-queue limits on failover.
- We will prepare a one-page exec RCA and a runbook of permanent mitigations (dns resolver diversity, health-based routing).

I’ll keep you posted as we get the final captures — expectation is to have an initial RCA within 24 hours and an executive summary within 72 hours. If you’d like immediate credits for the impacted window, I can start that process in parallel and loop in Finance.

Thanks for the patience. I know this is impactful; our priority is to restore stable token throughput and eliminate the 5xxs.

-Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Account Lead, Strategic Customers
Redwood Inference
